sentences.en: The leisure industry is sinking more money into new resorts.
sentences.zh: 1. 消闲行业正在向新的度假村投入更多的资金。

sentences.en: The ship set sail only to sink two days later.
sentences.zh: 2. 这艘船启航后两天就沉没了。

sentences.en: The implications of this did not at first sink in.
sentences.zh: 3. 这一点最初并没有被理解。
